a.xlink:title: XDP entry: EtherType demux, no VLAN/MPLS. Non-IP (incl. ARP) accepts as XDP_PASS without entering the parser.
parse_l3_headers v4: ihl != 5 or any fragment -> XDP_DROP.
parse_l3_headers v6: Fragment nexthdr -> DROP; ICMPv6 -> inner; no extension-header walk (any other nexthdr is the L4 proto). TCP/UDP dispatch, else PASS.
Proto dispatch (no extract): ICMP inner, TCP, UDP, else PASS.
parse_icmp (v4): echo (8) accepts [-> XDP_TX]; DEST_UNREACH (3) parses the inner packet; any other type accepts [PASS].
Shared L4 terminal (outer or inner): the projection lifts ports (swapped under is_icmp) and TCP SYN/RST flags.
parse_icmpv6: echo (128) accepts [TX]; DEST_UNREACH (1) / PKT_TOOBIG (2) parse inner; else PASS.
Inner v4 (ICMP error payload): ihl != 5 -> DROP; no frag check (katran's parse_icmp doesn't). is_icmp marks the inversion for the projection.

Inner v6: nexthdr taken directly (no frag/ext check in parse_icmpv6). TCP/UDP else PASS. Reuses the `ipv6` instance (its 128-bit addresses are var_bytes, which the IR cannot carry under two instance names); the projection reads the LAST ipv6 under `is_icmp`, so the inner addresses win on the ICMP path exactly as katran records them.
